newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's ASTRA raised to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's ASTRA raised to "buy".

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its intermediate term rating of Argentina's oil firm ASTRA Compania Argentina de Petroleo SA to "buy" from "accumulate."
-- "The underlying trends in ASTRA's main business as demonstrated in the third quarter suggest good growth opportunities," analyst Frank McGann said in a report.
-- "We expect that earnings in 1997 can grow 20 percent to $60.3 million or $0.144 per share vs $50.2 million or $0.119 per share this year."
--"Growth is expected to come primarily as a result of higher upstream results."
-- "Beyond 1997, we believe ASTRA is positioned to grow its core energy businesses, both in oil and gas and in electricity."
-- "The recent acquisition by Repsol of Spain of a 37.7 percent controlling interest in the company should be viewed as a major positive in this regard."
